title: Phone Slip: Rádio Voz do Centro — Buzi Staff and Wet Stock

fields.message: Asks: 1) Are HRI staff missing in Buzi? A committee man there says our car went into the river at Guara-Guara. True? 2) Our port warehouse lost its roof. Is the cyclone aid 'rotting in the rain'? 3) Will HRI go to Buzi today or not? He says he will NAME our staff if we don't comment. He got first names from a family member. Email: redaccao@vozdocentro.example. Who clears this, Beira or Geneva??

instructorNote: Pressure inject testing who clears media lines during a missing-staff incident. Under HMSSSP 8 the CMT chair should approve one holding line, checked with the CD, before 10:30. It should say HRI is accounting for all staff and working with the authorities, give no names, not repeat the vehicle report or speculate about Buzi, and state the facts on the warehouse: damage is being assessed and only usable stock is reported to partners. The line should also ask the reporter not to name staff, for the families' sake.
